_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'. Rust files carry inline #[cfg(test)] modules, so an entry is either a bare line count or {lines, prod}, where prod is the part before that module and is what maxNewFileLines applies to.
